title: ExceptionalFiniteProperMate
statement: In the notation of def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces and def-sf-exceptional-system-interfaces, assume every O/(ell^(n+1)) is finite. For supplied proper/open compactifications S and P and their normalized comparison R, the mate of the finite proper inverse-image square R.properSquare.derivedLevel n is invertible at every bounded-below object of the finite etale coefficient category of c.Z. This is solely the proper finite mate, with no exceptional support, open, right-adjoint or origin conclusions.

source.place: Zheng Lemma 4.10 and Construction 5.15; Stacks 099R and 0B65, finite coefficient proper direct-image comparison.

proof.text: Identify modules over the constant finite quotient-ring sheaf with sheaves of modules over the quotient ring. The specified geometric underlying inverse-image maps and scalar-action normalizations identify the ordinary lifts with the usual fixed-coefficient inverse-image operations. Their exact localizations and right-derived adjoints identify the derived operations and preserve the normalized square.

Taking mates under these identifications gives the canonical fixed-coefficient proper comparison, with its actual unit and counit normalization. That comparison is invertible on bounded-below objects for a proper, hence qcqs, morphism. Transport its inverse through the identifications.
